title: 回归样本：每天进步一点就够了（非用户原项目）
english: You do not have to change everything today. One small step can make a real difference. Read one page and learn something new. Practice one sentence slowly and say it clearly. When you make a mistake, try once more. Be patient with yourself on difficult days. Notice the progress you have already made. Your small efforts will grow over time. Tomorrow you can take another gentle step. A little progress every day is enough.
chinese: 你不必在今天改变一切。小小的一步也能带来真正的改变。读一页书，学一点新知识。慢慢练习一句话，把它说清楚。犯错的时候，再试一次。在困难的日子里，对自己耐心一点。看看自己已经取得的进步。小小的努力会随着时间积累。明天，你还可以再迈出温柔的一步。每天进步一点，就已经足够了。

character.name: Emma / 艾玛
